desc: Ideate candidate approaches (residual-path DP, forced edge-cut characterization, general cut-edge DP, center/arm pairing, leaf forcing).

Implement and test the forced edge-cut characterization solution in Python: read N,K and edges; if K=1 print Yes; root the tree iteratively at vertex 1; compute subtree sizes modulo K; keep exactly edges whose child subtree size modulo K is nonzero; verify every connected component of kept edges has maximum degree at most 2 and exactly K vertices; print Yes iff all checks pass.
